Text: I have been using this coffee since purchasing my Keurig B60 brewer. It is a great tasting flavored coffee which I start my day with. I highly recommend this coffee for anyone who likes a great cup of delicious coffee.

It makes an awesome cup of coffee on the large mug setting; I love to have a cup when unwinding from a stressful day.
